h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ambarnath

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ambarnath

items.pText: Ambarnath is only about 33 km from our factory in Vasai, both of us on the edge of the Mumbai region. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor playground equipment manufacturer that supplies housing societies, builders, schools and the industrial units around Ambarnath. Being this close means our installation team can reach your site easily, and you deal directly with the people who make the equipment.

New residential projects have been filling the stretch between Kalyan, Ambarnath and Badlapur, and most of them include a children's play area. The main thing to plan for here is the monsoon. From June to September the Mumbai region gets very heavy rain, and open ground turns to mud within days. A society that wants a playground ready for the rains should settle the layout and the order before the monsoon begins. The posts can then be grouted and the flooring laid on dry ground. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle the wet months without rusting.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Getting a society playground ready before the monsoon

c: Work backwards from June. Approve the layout and quote early enough for manufacturing, then keep the ground levelled and ready for installation. Concrete for grouted posts needs dry weather to set, and rubber flooring should go down on a dry, firm base.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How close is your factory to Ambarnath?
items.a: Our factory is in Vasai East, about 33 km from Ambarnath. The equipment is made there, sent by road and installed by our own installation team.

items.q: Can you install a playground during the monsoon?
items.a: It is possible on a covered or paved site, but grouting and rubber flooring set best on dry ground. We suggest finishing installation before June or planning it after the heavy rain ends.

items.q: Can our society add an outdoor gym along with the playground?
items.a: Yes. Many societies place a few Fun Fitness machines near the play area so parents can exercise while children play. We can show both on one layout drawing.
